verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for an equity-management SaaS platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an in-product AI assistant or agent that users can delegate tasks to. The evidence covers cap table management, round and waterfall modeling, 409A valuations, e-signing, data rooms and white-glove migration done by human staff. An llms.txt file only makes the site readable to outside AI tools and is not an assistant inside the product.
